title: William Stephenson's Caribbean activities and ties to scientists

tellings.quote: And he was doing a lot of stuff in and around the Caribbean, the Bahamas, the Virgin Islands.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking in an episode about Jeffrey Epstein and aliens, describes a man named William Stephenson who, he says, was busy in and around the Caribbean, the Bahamas and the Virgin Islands from the 1940s on. Michels links Stephenson to the American spy chief Bill Donovan, to scientists such as the electrical engineer Charles Steinmetz and the inventor Townsend Brown, and to the businessman Robert Maxwell. He tells it to suggest a long, hidden web tying intelligence work, unusual science and later figures together.
